title: Correct final magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the magnitude of the force as 2 N.

title: Correct final direction
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the direction of the force as vertically upward.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply conservation of mechanical energy to find the ball's speed at the highest point.

title: Newton's second law at P
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Newton's second law (F_net = m v^2/L) to the ball at the highest point.

title: Force identification and third law
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly identify the rod-on-ball force from the net force and apply Newton's third law to find the ball-on-rod force.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (kg, m, s, N) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign/direction error for force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the direction of the force (e.g., stating downward) is incorrect or if the sign in the force balance equation (F + mg = mv^2/L) is wrong.

title: Energy or centripetal formula misuse
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize major errors such as omitting potential energy in conservation or using incorrect centripetal acceleration (e.g., v^2/r vs. other).
